reason: Both pages chose the same idea (split hero with a live freezer finder), but A executes it as a coherent system: labelled at the top of the artifact, answer visible in the first viewport at 390, edge inputs handled with written states, and taking a tube out in the hero shows up in the manager log further down. B has the more polished type and the better 'what it replaces' mocks, and would win if its label moved to the top of the card, its phone layout showed the answer above the fold, and its phone mock and history stayed consistent with the grid.
